# Memos

     `memo check` fails when it is stale. Do not edit. -->

## Invariants

- [every-artifact-lands-inside-the-board](every-artifact-lands-inside-the-board.md) — decided · 2026-09-01 — every file the tool writes into a project lands under that project's .pearde/

## Decisions

- [the-dispatcher-holds-no-round](the-dispatcher-holds-no-round.md) — decided · 2026-09-01 — the round runs in a pearde-round worker whose window is thrown away, and the budget is measured from the window's own floor
- [invariants-are-testable-memos-and-the-kind-index-is-generated](invariants-are-testable-memos-and-the-kind-index-is-generated.md) — decided · 2026-09-01 — invariants are testable memos and the kind index is generated
- [the-round-has-a-context-ceiling](the-round-has-a-context-ceiling.md) — superseded · 2026-08-31 — a round is capped at 100k context and resumed from the round file, and workers are dispatched as typed agents
- [the-board-keeps-two-journals](the-board-keeps-two-journals.md) — decided · 2026-08-31 — .history.jsonl and .transitions.jsonl are two different records, not one duplicated
- [the-record-is-always-whole](the-record-is-always-whole.md) — decided · 2026-08-29 — collect must never stage a PRD's own folder by hunk, and the state it writes after staging must land in the same commit
- [the-tool-moves-the-states](the-tool-moves-the-states.md) — decided · 2026-08-28 — Every transition is a command that checks its own gate, and the prose becomes the spec of the tool
- [the-persona-lives-in-the-shell](the-persona-lives-in-the-shell.md) — decided · 2026-08-28 — The session's persona is `PEARDE_AS` in the environment — exported once at install, re-exported on a switch, never a board file
- [the-orchestrator-may-write-a-spec](the-orchestrator-may-write-a-spec.md) — decided · 2026-08-28 — The orchestrator may write a spec, and only to close a rule the PRD already states
- [init-defaults-the-language](init-defaults-the-language.md) — decided · 2026-08-28 — A board is created with no question — language defaults to English and says so on the first line
- [adjacent-edits-merge-into-one-hunk](adjacent-edits-merge-into-one-hunk.md) — decided · 2026-08-28 — Two workers editing adjacent lines produce one `-U0` hunk, and `collect` cannot tell whose it is
- [a-parked-child-holds-the-parent](a-parked-child-holds-the-parent.md) — decided · 2026-08-28 — scan's ready band ignores a parked child; claim's gate counts it — one rule has to win
- [a-manifest-row-can-name-a-directory](a-manifest-row-can-name-a-directory.md) — decided · 2026-08-28 — A growing data directory gets one manifest row for the directory, not one per file
- [the-scan-is-one-call](the-scan-is-one-call.md) — decided · 2026-08-27 — Step 1 is one `plan.py scan` call and one round file, never a hand-walked tree
- [the-guard-enforces-the-loop](the-guard-enforces-the-loop.md) — decided · 2026-08-27 — The loop's three token rules are a PreToolUse hook, not three sentences

## Notes

- [two-holes-the-flag-probe-found](two-holes-the-flag-probe-found.md) — decided · 2026-08-29 — collect defaults the persona silently where every transition refuses, and `set --force` leaves a stale `claim:`
- [the-install-is-live-symlinks](the-install-is-live-symlinks.md) — decided · 2026-08-29 — The installed skill is file-by-file symlinks into this repo, so a pearde round on any board on the machine edits this working tree
- [a-container-cannot-reach-done](a-container-cannot-reach-done.md) — decided · 2026-08-29 — a parent PRD whose children are all done has no path to done through the tool
- [one-typo-crashes-every-round](one-typo-crashes-every-round.md) — open · 2026-08-28 — a non-numeric complexity in any spec crashes scan board-wide, three lines from the try/except that would prevent it
- [a-drill-round-fails-its-own-checker](a-drill-round-fails-its-own-checker.md) — decided · 2026-08-28 — questions.py reads each prepared answer as a question, so a well-formed drill round reports six problems
